question: $P,Q$ and $R$ are statements such that if $P$ is true then at least one of the following is correct: (i) $Q$ is true, (ii) $R$ is not true. Then

options.A: if both $P$ and $Q$ are true then $R$ is true
options.B: if both $Q$ and $R$ are true then $P$ is true
options.C: if both $P$ and $R$ are true then $P$ is true
options.D: none of the statements is correct.

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
